props.heading: Academic Profile
props.body:
I am a student at Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS-II), Saugus, Massachusetts.

My focus combines academic rigor, research curiosity, and implementation discipline to turn ideas into practical systems.

This website is designed as a clear, professional research portfolio for mentors, peers, and collaborators.

props.description: Quick answers for collaborators, reviewers, and visitors.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of this site?
faqs.answer: This is a professional student portfolio that presents projects, direction, and collaboration channels in one place.

faqs.question: How can I review technical work quickly?
faqs.answer: Start with the Projects section and GitHub repositories, then check the journey page for context and progress.

faqs.question: How do collaboration requests work?
faqs.answer: Use the Support page and include your project idea, scope, and expected timeline.

faqs.question: Is this portfolio actively updated?
faqs.answer: Yes. New progress, documentation, and structural improvements are published continuously.
